purpose: Run MIRA through ChatGPT and optional MIRA companion apps against one durable MIRROR authority. MIRA has no disposable chat-only deployment mode.

product_model.mira: The assistant. Users primarily talk to MIRA in ChatGPT for planning, questions, reconciliation, configuration and approved actions.
product_model.mirror: The user's private data store and evidence record. MIRROR keeps settings, identities, evidence, relationships, history and structured state so every MIRA surface agrees on what is true.
product_model.mira_app: An optional display and data-ingestion companion. It captures physical-world data into MIRROR and displays MIRROR state written by the app, ChatGPT or other approved MIRA surfaces. It is useful but not required to use MIRA.

cloud.label: Cloud
cloud.plain_language: ChatGPT plus Google Workspace or Microsoft 365. Recommended for most people. No Linux or self-hosted server is required.

cloud_plus_self_hosted_services.label: Cloud + local services
cloud_plus_self_hosted_services.plain_language: Keep Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as MIRROR, while an enrolled MIRA app or bridge can reach local services such as Home Assistant, Plex or Paperless.

self_hosted.label: Self-hosted
self_hosted.plain_language: ChatGPT plus a user-owned MIRROR deployment. Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 may still be connected, but they are optional.

forbidden_modes.reason: MIRA must always have a durable MIRROR authority so state, settings and evidence survive conversation boundaries and remain consistent across surfaces.

onboarding.chatgpt_interview_purpose: Initialize the user's MIRA profile, choose one of the three MIRROR deployment choices, connect the selected durable authority, and configure requested life domains and preferences conversationally.
onboarding.mira_app_wizard_purpose: Configure that app/device, connect it to the same MIRROR authority, request device permissions, confirm or edit shared settings and teach capture/display workflows.

data_flow.mirror_to_chatgpt: The same verified MIRROR state is available to MIRA for conversation, reasoning and approved actions.

cloud_provider_native.mutable_authority: user-owned MIRROR records in the selected cloud provider
cloud_provider_native.evidence_authority: user-owned cloud files with MIRROR identity and provenance references

required_chain: create immutable MIRROR evidence or entity record
link it to the intended asset receipt location or other parent
store it in the selected MIRROR provider
verify provider write/readback or content hash
make the same relationship queryable by both ChatGPT and the MIRA app

model_access.preferred_distribution: MIRA plugin/skill using approved cloud-provider tools where available
model_access.fallback_custom_app_transport: OpenAI Apps SDK / MCP when a remote application backend is actually required

feature_delivery.safe_update_default: automatic or one press after release verification
feature_delivery.human_intervention: required only when custom source, policy, identity, or migration ambiguity cannot be reconciled safely
